Services in Bluffton, South Carolina

Five ways we grow
your business.

BaggottsBOTs Digital Marketing Agency builds a connected marketing system for businesses in Bluffton, Beaufort County, and Hilton Head Island. Pick the piece that's missing, or let us map the whole engine on a free strategy call.

01 / Social media management

Social that stops the scroll.

Strategy, content planning, and consistent posting across Facebook, Instagram, and X. We build a recognizable voice for your brand and keep it showing up, so local customers remember you.

  • Monthly content strategy and calendar
  • Posting, captions, and community engagement
  • Brand voice and visual direction

02 / Video production and editing

Video with main-character energy.

Short-form reels, brand stories, and promo videos, from concept and filming through edit, captions, and motion. We make your business look as good on screen as it is in person.

  • Short-form reels for Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok
  • Brand stories and promo videos
  • Captions, motion graphics, and editing

03 / Paid social advertising

Ads with a job to do.

Facebook and Instagram campaigns aimed at the people most likely to buy. We build creative, set up audiences, and test and refine. Ad spend is billed separately from management.

  • Campaign strategy and audience targeting
  • Ad creative and copy testing
  • Weekly optimization and reporting

04 / Landing pages

Pages that pull their weight.

Fast, mobile-first pages with one clear offer and one obvious next step. Every ad and post needs somewhere worth landing, and we build it.

  • Mobile-first design and fast load times
  • Lead forms wired to your follow-up
  • Connected to your ads and social posts

05 / AI chatbots and automation

A lead never left on read.

Business-specific AI chatbots answer common questions, capture inquiries, and power follow-up around the clock, with a planned handoff to a real person. Your chatbot can take calls and texts too, so no inquiry goes unanswered after hours.

  • 24/7 website chat and text replies
  • Phone line with call recording and summaries
  • Lead capture into your Google Sheet, with instant alerts
